description: This file contains utility functions for database operations within the Superset project, including database connection testing, permission management, and security-related object creation.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Tests the database connection by attempting to ping the database engine, handling specific exceptions for SQLite and duckdb.

methods.name: add_permissions
methods.description: Adds permissions for catalogs and schemas in the database, handling support for cross-catalog queries and multi-catalog configurations.

methods.name: add_vm
methods.description: Creates and adds a ViewMenu object to the session if it does not already exist.

methods.name: add_perm
methods.description: Creates and adds a Permission object to the session if it does not already exist.

methods.name: add_pvm
methods.description: Creates and adds a PermissionView object linking a permission and a view menu, ensuring atomicity without committing.
